candidate.title: UMI Method
candidate.scope: The central Illumina row titled UMI Method: a polyadenylated mRNA-fragment implementation of pre-amplification molecular tagging, cDNA synthesis, PCR and molecular-family sequence comparison. This is the depicted implementation, not every UMI assay. The mRNA icon is descriptive; no fragmentation operation is drawn. The neighboring viscRNA-seq row, lower Digital RNA/HiRes-Seq/RREQ-Seq row and right-hand RNA chemical scheme are separate context, with no connecting route to this target. Final DNA is interpreted as a representative sequence readout. The supplied primary paper is available here at abstract level only.

No perfect tag uniqueness, exhaustive mRNA recovery or exact counting estimator is established here.

evidence.rationale: If amplified copies retain their input molecular tag, they can be treated as one represented template family rather than counted as independent input molecules. operations.label: First strand synthesis
operations.description: Copy the polyadenylated mRNA fragment into a complementary first DNA strand. The depicted output remains paired with the RNA and shows poly(A)/poly(T) pairing, a CCC end and a P7-labelled extension.
operations.mechanism: RNA-templated cDNA synthesis at the level of the labelled strand-synthesis panel; the figure does not name the enzyme or explain formation of the CCC end.
operations.information_effect: Transfers transcript sequence into a DNA carrier while preserving its association with the template in the drawn hybrid.

operations.label: Second strand synthesis
operations.description: Convert the first-strand intermediate into the paired-strand product shown in the second synthesis panel, now bearing the annotated N10 degenerate molecular tag and P5/Index elements. operations.information_effect: Associates a degenerate molecular identifier with a template-derived DNA product before amplification. This identifies descendant copies by molecular family; the separate Index label is not identified as a cell barcode.

operations.label: Align fragments from every unique molecular tag
operations.description: Read out the amplified DNA as sequence fragments and align fragments sharing a molecular tag into a family. The expanding wedge and aligned fragments depict this interface; sequencing is implicit rather than a separately labelled reaction.
operations.information_effect: Turns the tagged physical library into grouped sequence observations. Recurring and discordant positions can be compared within the same molecular family.
